def main():
    s = input().strip()
    ans = [s[0]]
    k = 0
    i = 1
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        if i + 3 < n and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            ans.append('.')
            i += 3
            continue
        if k == 0 and i + 1 < n and s[i:i+2] == "at":
            ans.append('@')
            i += 2
            k = 1
            continue
        ans.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    print(''.join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
